section: Iterate — change: read the evidence quote from the Evidence line
title: Evidence-line quote grammar
context: Leadwright writes the shadow evidence quote on the Evidence bullet as '<pointer> — "<quote>"', not as a '> text — pointer' line in the fence. The webui showed 'unknown source', no quote, did not guard against copying the quote, and wrote null evidence to the audit.
decision: Mirrored grammar gets parseEvidence (greedy match, known short pointer required, otherwise unchanged). The view shows the quote first as plain text; proposalFacts folds it into the copy-guard needles; the audit keeps only the structured pointer. The leadwright renderEntry sample is pinned with a sha256 in the contract doc.
consequences: A quote of 20+ folded characters now blocks an unedited copy (400 line_contains_quote). Producer shapes other than the short pointer with ASCII spaces and a closed quote stay unknown source (documented). The 24-200 length rule is the producer's; the webui does not enforce it.
rationale: Smallest change that matches the producer: one pure function in the mirrored grammar, reused by the view and the server guard; no new write surface.
rejected: Adopting the '> text — pointer' fence form for the Evidence line (not what the producer writes); enforcing the 24-200 length in the webui (producer rule, no consumer benefit).
